{"findings":[{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D1","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 30"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: 20MnCr5 # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2( 0.8) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.08 kg"}],"comment":"Dimension D1 defines the ⌀30 locating pin body but carries no fit or tolerance callout, even though the title states this is a locating pin and note N4 specifies a plating finish. Without a defined fit class the mating hole size cannot be determined, so the pin may not locate correctly; the designer should add an appropriate locational or drive-fit tolerance to D1."
    ,
"recommended_correction":"Add a fit tolerance (e.g., h6, m6, or p6 as required by function) to dimension D1."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"12±0.02"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: 20MnCr5 # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2( 0.8) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.08 kg"}],"comment":"Dimension D11 has a total tolerance band of 0.04 mm on a part that note N4 requires to be zinc plated (I.Z.B.P.), yet the drawing does not state whether the ±0.02 limit applies before or after plating. Plating buildup can push the finished size out of tolerance and cause assembly interference; the designer should specify whether the tolerance includes the plating thickness or adjust the nominal/tolerance accordingly."
    ,
"recommended_correction":"Clarify on the drawing whether the ±0.02 tolerance on D11 applies before or after plating, and adjust the nominal dimension or tolerance band to account for the expected coating thickness."}]}
